**Yes—compared with bare-metal stents.** In the randomized COMFORTABLE AMI trial, patients with acute MI assigned to biodegradable-polymer biolimus-eluting stents had fewer 1-year primary composite events—cardiac death, target-vessel MI, or ischemia-driven target-lesion revascularization—than those assigned to bare-metal stents (4.3% vs 8.7%; HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.31–0.78; PMID: 23078828).

**Important qualification:** this shows benefit over bare-metal stents; it does not establish that this stent is superior to contemporary drug-eluting stents, nor does the composite result alone establish a mortality benefit.
